page_title: IPS 2-2 AST | Ipswich v Aston Villa 29/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Stuart Attwell has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' The resulting corner from Leif Davis (Ipswich) is cleared by the defence.

90+5' Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick inside the box and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save. Ipswich force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+5' Leif Davis (Ipswich) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

90+4' Jack Taylor (Ipswich) won himself some space after the corner kick and tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box. His effort is directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes the save.
90+4' Leif Davis (Ipswich) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
90+3' George Hirst (Ipswich) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Corner kick. Ipswich will have an opportunity.
90+1' Substitution. Jack Clarke walks off the pitch and Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) comes on as a substitute.
90+1' Here is a change. Samy Morsy is going off and Kieran McKenna gives the last tactical orders to Massimo Luongo (Ipswich).
90+1' The manager makes a subsitution with George Hirst (Ipswich) coming on for Liam Delap.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Arijanet Muric easily deals with the threat.

88' Leif Davis (Ipswich) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
87' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
87' Leif Davis (Ipswich) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Ipswich.

86' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) takes the free kick from the edge of the box and fires the ball goalwards. The goalkeeper can stay calm as the shot sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
85' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
84' Substitution. Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) on for Youri Tielemans.
84' Unai Emery prepares a substitution. Ollie Watkins is replaced by Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa).
84' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) for Lucas Digne.
83' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jack Taylor (Ipswich) brought his opponent down. Aston Villa are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
83' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 6:0.
82' Leif Davis (Ipswich) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

81' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Wes Burns (Ipswich) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball is out of play. Ipswich will have a chance to score from a corner.
80' Liam Delap (Ipswich) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.

79' The corner kick is deflected to Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich), who immediately sends in a long-range shot. However, he hits the ball poorly and it goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
78' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
78' One of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital stop to deny a close-range header from Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich). Ipswich earn a corner.
74' The referee Stuart Attwell awards Jacob Greaves (Ipswich) a yellow card.
74' Unlucky! A great strike from Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
72' 2 - 2 Liam Delap (Ipswich) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Emiliano Martinez with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:2.
71' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle. Samy Morsy (Ipswich) commits a foul after dangerous play. Aston Villa will take a free kick.
69' That will be all from Kalvin Phillips who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jack Taylor (Ipswich).
69' Kieran McKenna decides to make a substitution. Chiedozie Ogbene will be replaced by Wes Burns (Ipswich).
69' Leif Davis (Ipswich) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
67' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
67' Stuart Attwell interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Leif Davis (Ipswich). A free kick has been awarded to Aston Villa.
64' Unai Emery has decided to substitute Leon Bailey and he is replaced by Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa).
64' Substitution. Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) replaces Morgan Rogers.
63' Aston Villa are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.

60' What an opportunity! Samy Morsy (Ipswich) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post! The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
60' Surely that's handball by one of the Aston Villa players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
57' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Stuart Attwell saw the whole situation. A free kick to Aston Villa.
54' Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
54' Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) sends the corner into the box, but Emiliano Martinez intercepts it and averts the threat.

54' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Ipswich will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
52' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Aston Villa is cautioned for aggressive play.
49' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
46' That's a clear yellow card. Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) goes into the book.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' The referee can't ignore those comments and Liam Delap (Ipswich) sees a yellow card for bad language.
45+2' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
45' Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
44' A player from Ipswich commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
43' Ipswich force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
43' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich).
42' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) swings it in and Ollie Watkins gets on the end of it, but Arijanet Muric shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
40' It looks like Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) saw red with that tackle. Stuart Attwell won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Ipswich.
39' Leif Davis (Ipswich) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

38' Emiliano Martinez pulls off a great save to deny Liam Delap (Ipswich) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! Ipswich have a corner.
37' Leif Davis (Ipswich) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

37' Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
35' Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The linesman signals a throw-in for Ipswich.
32' 1 - 2 Goal! Leon Bailey picks out Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) with a perfect cross, and he has no problem to nod the ball into an empty net. It's 1:2.
30' The ball is cleared after Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
29' Liam Delap (Ipswich) plays a long ball to Jack Clarke, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
27' Some great controlled play and passing from Aston Villa. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
26' Stuart Attwell blows for a foul after Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
25' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
23' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Stuart Attwell has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
22' The referee blows his whistle as Samy Morsy (Ipswich) was too aggressive in his challenge. Aston Villa win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
22' Ipswich hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
21' Aston Villa exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.

19' Leif Davis sends a terrific cross into the box. Jack Clarke (Ipswich) gets on the end of it but his header from the centre of the box goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.

18' What an opportunity! Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
15' 1 - 1 Goal! Ollie Watkins shows great vision to find Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 1:1.

14' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) and Ezri Konsa have been trying to find each other with some accurate passes ever since the match started. These two definitely combine the most and are the team's most creative players.
12' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
10' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) and Ezri Konsa combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.
8' 1 - 0 Jack Clarke feeds the ball through to Liam Delap (Ipswich), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:0!
7' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul. Ipswich are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
4' What a long-range shot by Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
4' Liam Delap (Ipswich) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
3' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) plays a one-two with Morgan Rogers, but the move breaks down.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Ipswich will have the kick-off.
